$comment: Machine-readable infra map for QCI SAMAR (schema: ~/.claude/conventions/infra-map.md). This repo OWNS the shared facts (hosts, environments, DBs) for the constellation; sibling repos carry thin files pointing here. Non-secret — credentials live in the committed .env* / appsettings files per the layered-env convention. Deploy procedure: deploy/README.md.

constellation.$comment: The *-old repos (backend/web/assessor-mobile) are retired — ignore them. API contract lands in backend first; backend is source of truth.

environments.$comment: No production environment exists. As of 20-Aug-2026 the mobile store builds deliberately point at staging (docs/10-architecture/D-007) — a PILOT release: the apps are distributed through the stores for testing, staging keeps its testing posture, and the apps are released again against the real production backend once one exists.

vm-webhost-dev-cin-01.tls: samar-api.webority.dev: Let's Encrypt via certbot, AUTO-RENEW VERIFIED (certbot.timer active, twice daily; checked 18-Jul-2026, expiry 14-Oct-2026). Mobile pins target ISRG roots, so LE renewals do NOT break pinned builds. samar.webority.dev: CF-proxied, shared *.webority.dev origin cert
vm-webhost-dev-cin-01.backups: none — pre-production estate, accepted (Navneet, 18-Jul-2026); revisit when production is provisioned
vm-webhost-dev-cin-01.notes: Shared Webority dev web host. Fixed egress IP — partner IP-whitelisting (Protean GST, ICICI UAT). Dev API domain is DNS-only (NOT Cloudflare-proxied): mobile apps pin ISRG roots; Let's Encrypt direct.

qci-staging-vm.ownership: CUSTOMER-HOSTED (confirmed Navneet 18-Jul-2026) — this VM belongs to QCI, not Webority; we hold deploy access via the PEM. The dev VM is ours, this one is theirs.
qci-staging-vm.tls: samar-staging1.qci.org.in — cert on the server-managed nginx on the CUSTOMER's VM (their DNS, their cert responsibility; VERIFY issuer/renewal only if an expiry incident arises)
qci-staging-vm.backups: none on our side — customer-hosted staging VM; pre-production estate (Navneet, 18-Jul-2026). Still accepted under the D-007 pilot store release (the store apps are a testing distribution channel, not a production launch). Trigger to revisit: production provisioning, or real dependence on staging data arriving before it.
qci-staging-vm.notes: Fixed egress IP for partner whitelisting. nginx config is server-managed (/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/qci-samar.conf) — the deploy script does NOT overwrite it. Security-header snippet source of truth: deploy/nginx/qci-security-headers.conf.

manualOnly: everything — ./deploy/deploy.sh [all|backend|frontend|dev|staging|status] over SSH/rsync from a dev machine (deploy/README.md)
cicd.$comment: No GitHub Actions in any QCI repo. The script refuses dirty tree / non-development branch and parity-checks deployed_commit after.

guards: Deploy scripts intentionally ship ALL .env* files (layered loader) — never 'harden' the rsync to exclude them; the app boots broken without them
Never overwrite staging nginx config — /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/qci-samar.conf is server-managed; repo snippet deploy/nginx/qci-security-headers.conf is the only nginx piece we own

deploy-staging.sh fresh runs migrate:fresh --seed — DESTRUCTIVE, wipes staging data; never run it as a routine deploy. Since D-007 that data also includes pilot store users' work — check who is mid-assessment before anyone runs it deliberately.
Mobile staging builds pin TLS certs — rotating the API cert without a coordinated app release bricks the pinned builds
Partner integrations (Protean GST, ICICI) whitelist our fixed egress IPs — changing VM/IP breaks partners until re-whitelisted

No production BACKEND exists — anything called 'prod' in the backend/web configs is a placeholder; do not deploy to it. The mobile apps are the exception: their appsettings.Production.json deliberately carries the STAGING BASE_URL so store builds work (D-007). 'Production' in a mobile appsettings means 'the config a store build ships with', not a production backend.
Staging carries the PILOT store apps (D-007) — internal staging testing shares the qci_samar DB with pilot store users, both directions

deploy.$comment: Refuses dirty tree / non-development branch. Ships ALL .env* files deliberately (layered loader) — never 'harden' that away. Version source: APP_VERSION in base .env, surfaced at /api/health + X-Api-Version.

development.$comment: served by pm2 app 'samar-frontend' (node build/server.js, PORT 3010) behind nginx

logs.$comment: dev: pm2 logs samar-frontend; staging is static nginx — nginx logs

health: /version.json (version + buildTime — the SPA deploy marker and readiness probe)
/ (SPA shell 200) — insufficient alone, the fallback answers 200 to everything

settings: samar-api.webority.dev is DNS-only (NOT proxied) — mobile cert pinning against ISRG roots; proxying it breaks the apps
staging domain samar-staging1.qci.org.in is on QCI's DNS, not ours

integrations.erp: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central outbound push (BC_*)
integrations.notes: Partner endpoints whitelist our fixed egress IPs (see hosts).

monitoring.$comment: Standard: ~/.claude/conventions/monitoring.md. DELIBERATELY NOT IMPLEMENTED for this estate (Navneet, 20-Aug-2026): no alerting, no availability tests, no action group. This is a pre-production estate on a customer-hosted VM with the mobile apps in a D-007 pilot — the monitoring baseline is a production control and is not wanted yet. Revisit when a production environment is provisioned; do not re-raise it as a gap before then.

healthCheckPaths.samar-frontend: /version.json (version + buildTime; the deploy marker and probe in one) — currently probed at / by nothing automated

monitoring.escalation: None, deliberately — see $comment. Not a gap to close until production exists.
gaps: No alerting or availability testing anywhere in this constellation — a DECISION, not an oversight (see $comment). Outages are found by users or by manual checks until production is provisioned.
samar-frontend publishes /version.json (generated by scripts/prebuild.js, live on dev + staging) but nothing probes it. Available whenever monitoring is wanted.

pending.intent: Provision a production environment (API + frontend + DB) and fill environments.production plus each deployable's production entry
pending.when: QCI commits to a production host; triggers the mobile repoint + store re-release per D-007

log.change: Staging became the backend for the pilot mobile store release (D-007) — still a testing environment, but now with external app users
